content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be platform-agnostic, allowing creators to sell their digital products without relying on third-party services like Gumroad or PayPal. By leveraging GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, creators can build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. This approach not only reduces fees but also ensures that creators maintain full ownership and control over their data and sales.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to gather a few essential components. This includes a domain name, a GitHub account, and a NOWPayments API key. You'll also need to prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, courses, or templates, and ensure they are ready for delivery. With these elements in place, you can begin building your stack and start selling your products online.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack. You'll need to configure your NOWPayments API key, set up your Cloudflare Workers script, and connect your GitHub Pages site to your payment pipeline. This will enable automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your digital products.
Build a sovereign digital commerce stack and take control of your online sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed, you can go live and start processing transactions. You'll need to test your payment pipeline to ensure that it's working correctly, and then you can begin promoting your products to potential customers. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and with fees as low as 0.5%, you can keep more of your hard-earned revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your sales grow, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This may involve upgrading your Cloudflare Workers script, optimizing your GitHub Pages site, or adding more products to your catalog. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can scale your business without worrying about platform restrictions or payment processing limitations, allowing you to focus on creating and selling more digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use the COREMERCH infrastructure to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. This allows you to accept payments in crypto and deliver your products instantly, all while maintaining full ownership and control over your data and sales. With fees as low as 0.5%, you can keep more of your revenue and scale your business without platform restrictions.
Scale your business without platform restrictions or payment processing limitations.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. This kit provides everything you need to get started, and you can purchase it directly from the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. By investing in this kit, you can save time and money, and start selling your digital products online with confidence.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: configure your NOWPayments API key, set up your Cloudflare Workers script, connect your GitHub Pages site to your payment pipeline, test your payment pipeline, and go live. You'll also need to prepare your digital products, gather your essential components, and optimize your site for scalability. By following these steps, you can build a fully operational online store and start selling your digital products with ease.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges 0.5%. This means that at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you can retain $921 more with NOWPayments.
Can I use the COREMERCH infrastructure to sell physical products?
No, the COREMERCH infrastructure is designed specifically for selling digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates.
How do I set up my NOWPayments API key?
You can set up your NOWPayments API key by following the instructions on the NOWPayments website, or by consulting the documentation provided with the Complete Builder Kit.
What is the best way to optimize my GitHub Pages site for scalability?
You can optimize your GitHub Pages site for scalability by using a fast and reliable theme, minimizing page load times, and using a content delivery network (CDN).
Can I use the COREMERCH infrastructure to accept payments in fiat currency?
No, the COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to accept payments in cryptocurrency only, allowing you to take advantage of low fees and fast transaction times.
